faculty.name: Joseph P. Allen
faculty.summary: Studies how adolescent social relationships predict long-term health and behavior, focusing on peer influence and attachment security.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年的社会关系如何预测长期的心理健康和行为，重点关注同伴影响和依附安全。

faculty.name: Lanice Avery
faculty.summary: Studies the psychological and sexual health outcomes of Black women, focusing on the impact of gender and racial stereotypes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究黑人女性的心理和性健康结果，重点关注性别和种族刻板印象的影响。

faculty.name: Steve Boker
faculty.summary: Studies the dynamics of dyadic conversations, age-related changes in resilience, and adaptive dynamic models for addiction using Latent Differential Equations and Windowed Cross-Correlation methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成对对话的动力学、年龄相关的变化弹性和成瘾的适应动态模型，使用潜在差分方程和窗口交叉相关方法。

faculty.name: Jazmin Brown-Iannuzzi
faculty.summary: Studies psychological mechanisms perpetuating group-based inequalities and the consequences of status-related disparities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究维持群体不平等的心理机制及其地位相关差异的后果。

faculty.name: Erin Clabough
faculty.summary: Studies neurodevelopment and synaptic plasticity, focusing on the effects of ethanol on neural development and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育和突触可塑性，关注乙醇对神经发育和行为的影响。

faculty.name: Elise M. Clerkin
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development in children using behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，使用行为实验方法。

faculty.name: James A. Coan
faculty.summary: Studies the neural systems supporting social forms of emotion regulation, using fMRI and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会形式的情绪调节的神经机制，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和行为实验。

faculty.name: Jessica Connelly
faculty.summary: Studies the relationship between DNA methylation of the oxytocin receptor and behavior in humans and model systems, using epigenetic regulation and neural response methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究DNA甲基化与催产素受体在人类和模式生物中的行为关系，使用表观遗传调控和神经反应方法。

faculty.name: Benjamin Converse
faculty.summary: Studies goal pursuit in social systems, including social judgment, self-regulation, and decision making.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会系统中的目标追求，包括社会判断、自我调节和决策制定。

faculty.name: Lauren DiNicola
faculty.summary: Studies how the human brain supports complex cognitive functions, using precision neuroimaging to explore individual brain networks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何支持复杂的认知功能，使用精确神经成像技术探索个体脑网络。

faculty.name: Chad Dodson
faculty.summary: Studies factors contributing to false memories and eyewitness identification errors, particularly in relation to confidence, face recognition ability, and decision-time.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究导致虚假记忆和目击者识别错误的因素，特别是与信心、面部识别能力和决策时间的关系。

faculty.name: Alev Erisir
faculty.summary: Studies synaptic plasticity and neuronal connectivity in sensory pathways using electron microscopy and behavioral models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉通路中的突触可塑性和神经连接性，使用电子显微镜和行为模型。

faculty.name: Hudson Golino
faculty.summary: Develops new methodologies for assessing latent factors using network psychometrics and machine learning in psychology and health.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发使用网络心理测量学和机器学习评估潜在因素的新方法，应用于心理学和健康领域。

faculty.name: Tobias Grossmann
faculty.summary: Studies the development of social, cognitive, and brain processes in infants, focusing on adaptive social communication and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿期的社会、认知和大脑过程的发展，重点在于适应性社会交流和行为。

faculty.name: Donna Hearn
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and development in children, using behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知过程和发展，使用行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Teague Henry
faculty.summary: Studies statistical methods and models in psychological research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理研究中的统计方法和模型。

faculty.name: Noelle Hurd
faculty.summary: Studies the promotion of healthy development among marginalized adolescents and emerging adults, focusing on leveraging intergenerational relationships and disrupting systems of oppression.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究边缘化青少年和新兴成年人的健康发展，侧重于利用代际关系并打破压迫系统。

faculty.name: Vikram Jaswal
faculty.summary: Studies communication in autism, focusing on cognitive and social processes in nonspeaking autistics and their unique communication methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自闭症患者的沟通，特别是非说话自闭症患者及其父母的认知和社会过程和独特沟通方式。

faculty.name: Angeline Lillard
faculty.summary: Studies social and cognitive development in children, focusing on Montessori education and play.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的社会和认知发展，重点关注蒙特梭利教育和游戏。

faculty.name: Xiaorong Liu
faculty.summary: Studies the degeneration of retinal ganglion cells in mouse models of glaucoma, using genetics, imaging, and neuroprotection strategies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视网膜神经节细胞在实验性青光眼小鼠模型中的退化，使用遗传学、成像和神经保护策略。

faculty.name: Patricia Llewellyn
faculty.summary: Studies health psychology, personality assessment, and women's issues, focusing on treatment outcomes and assessment in therapy training.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究健康心理学、人格评估和女性问题，重点关注治疗结果和疗法培训中的评估问题。

faculty.name: Nicole Long
faculty.summary: Studies how top-down and bottom-up processes affect memory encoding and retrieval using EEG and fMRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自上而下和自下而上的过程如何影响记忆编码和检索，并使用脑电图和功能性磁共振成像进行表征。

faculty.name: Jennifer MacCormack
faculty.summary: Studies social influence and self-perception using experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会影响和自我知觉，使用实验方法。

faculty.name: Channing Mathews
faculty.summary: Studies how youth of color use ethnic-racial identity and critical consciousness to engage in STEM and activism.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究有色人种青年如何利用种族身份认同和批判意识参与STEM和行动。

faculty.name: Chris Mazurek
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their development in children, using behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童认知过程及其发展，使用行为实验方法。

faculty.name: C. Daniel Meliza
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of pattern learning and recognition in songbirds using electrophysiology and dynamical systems models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究鸟类听觉系统中模式学习和识别的神经机制，使用电生理学和动力系统模型方法。

faculty.name: Michael Meyer
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on working memory and attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注工作记忆和注意力。

faculty.name: James P. Morris
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of social behavior, using fMRI, EEG/ERP, and behavioral experiments across the lifespan.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会行为的神经机制，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图/事件相关电位（EEG/ERP）和行为实验贯穿整个生命周期。

faculty.name: Alison Nagel
faculty.summary: Studies clinical psychology, focusing on therapy and assessment.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事临床心理学研究，专注于治疗和评估。

faculty.name: Brian A. Nosek
faculty.summary: Studies how people and systems produce values-misaligned behavior, developing methods to align behavior with values and improving research methods and culture.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们和系统如何产生价值观不一致的行为，开发方法以使行为与价值观一致，并改进研究方法和文化。

faculty.name: Paul Perrin
faculty.summary: Studies social determinants of health and cultural approaches to disability rehabilitation, using community-based participatory research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究健康的社会决定因素和残疾康复的文化方法，采用社区参与式研究方法。

faculty.name: Aaron Reuben
faculty.summary: Studies the neuropsychiatric effects of environmental exposures across the lifespan, using advanced technologies and clinical assessments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究环境暴露对全生命周期神经心理健康的影響，使用先進技術和臨床評估方法。

faculty.name: Adema Ribic
faculty.summary: Studies how neurons assemble into circuits and adapt to the environment in the rodent visual system, using electrophysiology and gene manipulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元如何组装成回路并适应环境，使用电生理学和单神经元基因操作技术在啮齿动物视觉系统中进行研究。

faculty.name: Zoë Robertson
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development in children using behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，使用行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Karen M. Schmidt
faculty.summary: Studies the latent structure of complex abilities across the lifespan, personality, and pain, using item response theory models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究复杂能力的潜在结构、人格和疼痛，使用项目反应理论模型。

faculty.name: Per Sederberg
faculty.summary: Studies the neural correlates and computational models of human memory processes, combining fMRI, EEG, and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类记忆过程的神经相关性和计算模型，结合使用功能性磁共振成像、脑电图和行为实验。

faculty.name: Stefanie Sequeira
faculty.summary: Studies how social threat and reward processes develop during childhood and adolescence, linking brain and social behavior to understand psychopathology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年时期的社会威胁和奖励过程的发展，将大脑和社交行为联系起来，以理解心理障碍的发展。

faculty.name: Eric Shuman
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and behavior using experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程和行为，使用实验方法。

faculty.name: Bethany A. Teachman
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes contributing to anxiety disorders and emotion dysregulation, using digital technologies to improve emotional functioning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍和情绪调节的认知过程，使用数字技术改善情绪功能。

faculty.name: Mariana Teles
faculty.summary: Studies how people learn and designs educational interventions to support effective learning, using cognitive psychology, computational tools, and AI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人的学习机制，并设计教育干预措施以支持有效学习，结合认知心理学、计算工具和人工智能。

faculty.name: Xin Cynthia Tong
faculty.summary: Develops and applies Bayesian and longitudinal statistical methods to study the development of cognitive ability and achievement skills over time.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和应用贝叶斯和纵向统计方法研究认知能力和成就技能的纵向发展。

faculty.name: Sophie Trawalter
faculty.summary: Studies how people develop competencies for life in diverse spaces, focusing on intergroup contact and social cognition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何在多元空间中发展生活技能，重点关注群体间接触和社会认知。

faculty.name: Eric Turkheimer
faculty.summary: Studies how genes and environments interact to shape human behavior, focusing on family life and personality development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基因和环境如何相互作用塑造人类行为，重点关注家庭生活和个人特质的发展。

faculty.name: Amrisha Vaish
faculty.summary: Studies the development of moral emotions, cognitions, and behaviors in children, including sympathy, guilt, and cheating.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童道德情感、认知和行为的发展，包括同情、内疚和作弊。

faculty.name: John Van Horn
faculty.summary: Studies brain health and disease using multimodal neuroimaging and computational approaches, focusing on brain connectomics and white matter fiber pathways.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑健康和疾病，使用多模态神经成像和计算方法，重点关注大脑连接组学和白质纤维束路径。

faculty.name: Katherine Venturo-Conerly
faculty.summary: Studies how to personalize psychotherapies for youths to improve effectiveness and accessibility, using statistical methods and randomized control trials.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究如何个性化心理治疗以提高青少年的有效性和可及性，使用统计方法和随机对照试验。

faculty.name: Cedric Williams
faculty.summary: Studies how emotionally arousing events influence memory formation in the brain, using behavioral tasks and neurochemistry.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪激动事件如何影响大脑中的记忆形成，使用行为任务和神经化学方法。

faculty.name: Daniel Willingham
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their application to K-12 education, focusing on reading and learning styles.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其在K-12教育中的应用，重点关注阅读和学习风格。

faculty.name: Adrienne Wood
faculty.summary: Studies social connections and relationships, examining nonverbal and verbal behaviors, social networks, and community dynamics using various methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会联系和关系，考察非言语和言语行为、社会网络和社区动态，使用多种方法。

faculty.name: Stephen Abbott
faculty.summary: Studies the neural networks controlling cardiovascular and respiratory functions, and their role in diseases like neurogenic hypertension and Parkinson’s disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究调控心血管和呼吸功能的神经网络及其在神经性高血压和帕金森病等疾病中的作用。

faculty.name: David Acunzo
faculty.summary: Studies altered states of consciousness using cognitive neuroscience and neuroimaging techniques, particularly focusing on hypnosis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究意识改变状态，使用认知神经科学和神经成像技术，特别是关于催眠的研究。

faculty.name: Sameer Bajikar
faculty.summary: Studies genetic factors in neurodevelopment using systems biology approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育中的遗传因素，采用系统生物学方法。

faculty.name: Doug Bayliss
faculty.summary: Studies the biophysics of central neurons and neuromodulation using molecular pharmacology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究中枢神经细胞的生物物理特性和神经调制，使用分子药理学方法。

faculty.name: Mark Beenhakker
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and electrophysiology related to epilepsy, focusing on the thalamus.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究与癫痫相关的神经回路和电生理学，特别是丘脑的作用。

faculty.name: Ashley Brandebura
faculty.summary: Studies astrocyte heterogeneity and its role in neurodegeneration and neurodevelopment, particularly in Down Syndrome.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究星形胶质细胞异质性及其在唐氏综合症中神经退行性和神经发育障碍中的作用。

faculty.name: Jennifer Burnsed
faculty.summary: Studies how neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy and seizures affect brain development and later behavior in mice using electroencephalography and imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病和癫痫发作如何影响小鼠大脑发育和后期行为，使用脑电图和成像技术。

faculty.name: Jianhua Cang
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of vision, focusing on how sensory experience shapes visual functions in the cortex and visual information processing in the superior colliculus.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉神经基础，关注感觉经验如何在初级视皮层塑造视觉功能以及上丘中的视觉信息处理。

faculty.name: Anna Cliffe
faculty.summary: Studies the interaction between herpes simplex virus and neurons, focusing on neuroimmunology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究单纯疱疹病毒与神经元的相互作用，侧重于神经免疫学。

faculty.name: Barry Condron
faculty.summary: Studies neurodevelopment, focusing on synapses and synaptic plasticity in vision.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育，重点关注视觉中的突触和突触可塑性。

faculty.name: Elise Cope
faculty.summary: Studies how the hippocampus changes and its role in memory, focusing on perineuronal nets.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究海马可塑性及其在记忆中的作用，重点关注Perineuronal Nets.

faculty.name: Noelle Dwyer
faculty.summary: Studies axon outgrowth and neural stem cells in neurodevelopment and neurogenesis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育和神经发生中的轴突生长和神经干细胞。

faculty.name: Tanya Evans
faculty.summary: Studies autism spectrum disorder using fMRI to understand neurodevelopment.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）研究自闭症谱系障碍的神经发展机制。

faculty.name: Sarah Ewald
faculty.summary: Studies host-parasite interactions and immunity using proteomics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究宿主-寄生虫相互作用和免疫反应的蛋白质组学方法。

faculty.name: Heather Ferris
faculty.summary: Studies Alzheimer's disease, focusing on the role of cholesterol, diabetes, and metabolism.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病，关注胆固醇、糖尿病和代谢的作用。

faculty.name: Sarah Flowers
faculty.summary: Studies Alzheimer's disease biomarkers and metabolism to understand neurodegeneration.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病的生物标志物和新陈代谢，以理解神经退化。

faculty.name: Alban Gaultier
faculty.summary: Studies neurodegeneration and remyelination in multiple sclerosis, focusing on neuroimmunology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究多发性硬化症的神经退行性病变和再髓鞘化，侧重于神经免疫学。

faculty.name: Ali Deniz Guler
faculty.summary: Studies circadian rhythms and feeding behavior, exploring neurodegeneration mechanisms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究昼夜节律和进食行为，探索神经退行性疾病机制。

faculty.name: Tajie H. Harris
faculty.summary: Studies microglia and neuroimmunology, focusing on T cells.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究小胶质细胞和神经免疫学，重点关注T细胞。

faculty.name: Harris Kaplan
faculty.summary: Studies how immature neuronal circuits control infant behaviors, including sleep and social interactions, using mice as a model.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿行为（包括睡眠和社会互动）由未成熟神经回路控制的机制，使用小鼠作为模型。

faculty.name: Jaideep Kapur
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuits involved in epilepsy and seizures, focusing on neuronal networks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究癫痫和发作的神经环路，关注神经网络的作用。

faculty.name: Chia-Yi Kuan
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经机制。

faculty.name: Kyle Lampe
faculty.summary: Studies methods for CNS repair using biomaterials and tissue engineering.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究使用生物材料和组织工程方法修复中枢神经系统的方法。

faculty.name: Xin Li
faculty.summary: Studies aging, inflammation, metabolism, and wound healing in biological systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究衰老、炎症、代谢和伤口愈合的认知神经科学。

faculty.name: Xiaowei Lu
faculty.summary: Studies inner ear neurodevelopment and tissue morphogenesis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究内耳神经发育和组织形态发生。

faculty.name: Nadia Lunardi
faculty.summary: Studies neurobiological mechanisms of ICU delirium and sleep pathways.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究ICU谵妄和睡眠路径的神经生物学机制。

faculty.name: Wendy Lynch
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经机制。

faculty.name: Mani Mahadevan
faculty.summary: Studies genetic and molecular mechanisms of muscular dystrophy and neuromuscular disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究肌营养不良和其他神经肌肉疾病的遗传和分子机制。

faculty.name: Daniel Meliza
faculty.summary: Studies auditory systems and behavior using electrophysiology to understand neural circuits.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听觉系统和行为，使用电生理学方法理解神经回路。

faculty.name: Edward Nieh
faculty.summary: Studies addiction and feeding behavior using machine learning methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用机器学习方法研究成瘾和进食行为。

faculty.name: Manoj Patel
faculty.summary: Studies electrophysiology of ion channels in epilepsy, using electrophysiological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究癫痫中离子通道的电生理学，使用电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Kevin Pelphrey
faculty.summary: Studies autism spectrum disorder genetics and sex differences, using neuroimaging and behavioral assessments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自闭症谱系障碍的遗传学和性别差异，使用神经影像学和行为评估方法。

faculty.name: Edward Perez-Reyes
faculty.summary: Studies epilepsy using gene therapies and insulin replacement.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究癫痫的基因疗法和胰岛素替代疗法。

faculty.name: William A Petri
faculty.summary: Studies the immunology of COVID-19, focusing on the pathogenesis of the disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究 COVID-19 免疫学，专注于疾病的发生机制。

faculty.name: Richard Price
faculty.summary: Studies cancer drug delivery using focused ultrasound, focusing on neurodegeneration.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究使用聚焦超声的癌症药物递送，重点关注神经退行性疾病。

faculty.name: Elizabeth Proctor
faculty.summary: Studies Alzheimer’s disease and aging using neural circuits, neuroimmunology, and multi-omics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病和衰老的神经回路和神经免疫学多组学方法。

faculty.name: Javier Provencio
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of learning and memory in animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经基础。

faculty.name: Ignacio Provencio
faculty.summary: Studies the role of melanopsin-based photoreceptors in non-visual responses to light, including circadian rhythms and pupil constriction.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视网膜中黑皮质素光感受器在非视觉对光反应中的作用，包括昼夜节律和瞳孔收缩。

faculty.name: Meghan Puglia
faculty.summary: Studies how molecular factors influence social behavior and neural system variability across social-developmental trajectories.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究分子因素如何影响社会行为以及神经系统的变异性，特别是在社会发展的不同阶段。

faculty.name: Benjamin Purow
faculty.summary: Studies brain tumors and glioma, focusing on neurologic diseases.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑肿瘤和胶质瘤，专注于神经性疾病。

faculty.name: James Ross
faculty.summary: Studies neuroscience, focusing on the graduate program administration and possibly related research.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事神经科学研究，主要涉及研究生项目管理及相关研究。

faculty.name: Natasha Sheybani
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经机制。

faculty.name: Jung-Bum Shin
faculty.summary: Studies auditory systems and cellular/molecular neuroscience, focusing on sensory hair cells.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听觉系统和细胞/分子神经科学，专注于感觉毛细胞。

faculty.name: Sarah Siegrist
faculty.summary: Studies genetics and neural stem cells in neurodevelopment.
